title: Request time and arrest location are not encounter time or entry place

provenance.source: Team-authored synthetic generalization case (gen-v1), 2026-10-30. Not independently held out.

narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On March 12, 2024, at approximately 0815 hours, a Michigan State Police Trooper requested Border Patrol assistance with a traffic stop. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] arrived and encountered the subject at approximately 0900 hours near Detroit, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen and national of Mexico and that he does not possess any immigration documents allowing him to be in or remain in the United States legally. The subject presented a Mexican passport.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he crossed the Rio Grande near Brownsville, Texas, on July 1, 2017, without inspection, and was arrested in Detroit in 2024.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear and was served with a Warrant of Arrest.
